title: Hello Blueprint
description: Create a Blueprint Class that prints a message on BeginPlay.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Get comfortable with the Blueprint Editor by creating and testing your first logic.

1. In the Content Browser, create a new Blueprint Class (parent: Actor) named `BP_Hello`.
2. Open it and go to the **Event Graph**.
3. Right‑click → add **Event BeginPlay**.
4. Drag from its execution pin → add a **Print String** node.
5. Set the **In String** to `"Hello from Blueprint!"`.
6. **Compile** and **Save**.
7. Drag `BP_Hello` into your level and press Play.

**Expect:** The message appears on screen at game start.
hints: If you don't see the message, check that your level has a Player Start and you're playing in 'Selected Viewport' mode.
The message appears in the top‑left corner.
expectedOutput: The text 'Hello from Blueprint!' displayed on screen when the game starts.
solutionCode: Event BeginPlay → Print String (In String = "Hello from Blueprint!")
